definition: UniformGround A a d says that one and the same fact is admitted as a reason for d at every world accessible from a. It is the quantifier shift of LocallyGrounded and is strictly stronger: the truthmakers model has local grounds and no uniform ground.
note: Analyst-stated condition for #485; it is under test, not asserted. A sourced reading would need pinned witnesses for the grounding-of-disjunction literature listed on #485 (Merlo 2020, Trogdon 2013, Leuenberger 2014), none of which was read for this work.
